Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Backend Developer to join our technology team and play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining robust, scalable backend systems that power Standard Chartered's digital banking platform. The successful candidate will lead technical initiatives, build platfrom 0-1, and contribute to architectural decisions that with major business impact to our global financial market business.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Design and develop high-performance, scalable backend services and APIs using modern technologies
  • Implement microservices architecture patterns and distributed system design principles
  • Ensure system reliability, performance, and security across all backend services
  • Drive adoption of best practices in code quality, testing, and deployment
  • Make architectural decisions and contribute to technical strategy and roadmap planning

Development & Implementation

  • Build robust RESTful APIs and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and related technologies
  • Implement secure, efficient database designs and optimize query performance
  • Develop event-driven architectures using messaging systems (Solace, Kafka)
  • Integrate with third-party systems and external APIs following banking industry standards
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions

Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with front-end developers, SRE, QA, BA, product managers, and business stakeholders
  • Conduct thorough code reviews and provide constructive feedback
  • Lead technical discussions and facilitate knowledge sharing sessions
  • Participate in technical interviews and contribute to team building initiatives

Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure all backend systems comply with banking regulations and security standards
  • Implement comprehensive testing strategies including unit, integration, and performance testing
  • Drive continuous improvement in development processes and methodologies
  • Maintain high standards of documentation for systems and processes
  • Support production systems and participate in on-call rotations when required

Skills And Experience

  • Java (Spring Boot)
  • Relational DB
  • MQ
  • Logging, Monitoring and Alerts
  • Design Pattern
  • API

Qualifications

Technical Expertise

  • 5-8 years of experience in backend development with strong Java expertise
  • Proficiency in Spring Framework (Spring Boot)
  • Extensive experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (Redis)
  • Extensive experience with messaging systems (Solace, Apache Kafka)
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience in CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Experience with API design and development (REST, GraphQL)

Professional Skills

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking capabilities
  • Experience working in agile development environments
  • Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to explain complex technical concepts

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
  • Banking or financial services domain knowledge advantageous

Preferred Requirements

  • Knowledge of performance optimization and system scalability techniques
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack)

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

About The Opportunity

Job Type: Permanent

Application Deadline: 30 November 2026

Job Description

Title Technical Specialist - Collaboration Services

Department Enterprise Collaboration Services

Location Bangalore, Gurgaon or Dalian

Reports To Senior Technical Consultant

Level Technical Sepcialist

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our collaboration team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

About Your Team

We are a dynamic team who work to provide many services to the Fidelity International business globally. With a Service Catalogue of around 100 applications the Enterprise Collaboration Services team are responsible for many different technologies such as the support for all M365 services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive. We have a small Exchange on premise footprint and provide the means for secure email utilizing both TLS and OME. Always looking to improve and enable teams to automate tasks working in a DevOps environment.

About Your Role

Reporting to the Senior Technical Consultant, you will be a member of the Enterprise Collaboration Services Team. Responsibilities will be wide ranging including providing 3rd line support to our customers for all M365 services, as well as supporting other teams within Technology as appropriate. You also need to work on projects, and be part of UK hours shift support.

About You

  • Excellent knowledge of M365 suite of products including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, One Drive for Business and associated collaboration tools.
  • Experience of Teams as a Platform (inc voice) and consultancy on adopting Teams and automating business flow.
  • Excellent knowledge of MS Outlook.
  • Experience of Microsoft Cloud technologies including Azure & M365 Services with migration and operational experience.
  • Experience of Azure AD or an understanding of Access Package/Conditional Access policies.
  • Knowledge of security/Compliance concepts for AD, Azure AD, Microsoft Purview, and DLP desirable.
  • Experience using Power Platform, Power Apps, Power Automate, and PowerShell desirable.
  • Exchange 2016 & MS Edge troubleshooting experience and implementing and managing TLS/DKIM/DMARC.
  • Knowledge of networking concepts and technologies such as HTTP, SMTP, DNS, TCP/IP, and other web protocols, proxies and load balancers.
  • ITL certified (Desirable) with a knowledge of structured change management.

Feel rewarded

For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

The Software Engineer - Distributed Systems designs, builds, and supports highly scalable, resilient, and secure services for critical transaction processing environments. The role focuses on solving complex engineering problems across service orchestration, data consistency, failure recovery, observability, and performance at scale, delivering robust, high-throughput, low-latency critical banking systems. The engineer will be part of a high-performing team focused on engineering excellence and delivery quality. Experience with Go or Java is required. Experience with durable execution platforms such as Temporal, DBOS, or similar frameworks is a strong bonus.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Help shape the engineering direction for critical, high-availability distributed systems.
  • Contribute to long-term thinking around scalability, resilience, maintainability, and platform evolution.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows, reduce operational risk, and improve delivery speed.
  • Support adoption of better engineering practices, including automation, reusable patterns, and AI-assisted development where it adds value.
  • Think beyond immediate implementation to ensure solutions are robust, future-ready, and aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Bring structured problem-solving and strong critical thinking to ambiguous technical challenges.
  • Promote engineering excellence, code quality, and operational discipline.
  • Contribute to documentation, technical reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Undertake additional responsibilities as assigned within the scope of the role.
  • Apply secure engineering practices in line with internal governance and compliance expectations.
  • Build solutions that support integrity, reliability, traceability, and controlled operational behaviour.

Business

  • Design and build distributed backend services for high-volume transaction processing.
  • Develop scalable, fault-tolerant solutions for transaction-heavy systems.
  • Implement resilient integration patterns across APIs, queues, streaming platforms, and internal services.
  • Build strong validation, integrity, idempotency, and recovery mechanisms to support safe and consistent processing.
  • Deliver solutions that improve availability, consistency, and operational resilience.
  • Translate business and operational needs into well-structured technical implementations.

People and Talent

  • Collaborate effectively with engineering peers and contribute to a positive, high-performance team culture.
  • Share knowledge, learn continuously, and support skill development through strong technical contribution and example.
  • Demonstrate self-driven ownership, curiosity, and a strong can-do attitude.
  • Work constructively with others to solve hard technical problems and deliver against commitments.

Governance

  • Follow engineering standards, design principles, and delivery practices that support safe and reliable execution.
  • Apply disciplined software development practices, including testing, code quality, and maintainability.
  • Support the use of AI development tools responsibly through sound engineering judgement and hardening practices.
  • Maintain clear decision-making, traceability, and accountability in technical delivery.

Regulatory and Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Work with product, platform, engineering, and delivery stakeholders to ensure solutions meet technical and operational needs.
  • Engage with relevant technical partners to align on implementation approach, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
  • Communicate clearly on progress, risks, and technical decisions.
  • Build effective working relationships across teams to support delivery of complex engineering outcomes.

Other Responsibilities

  • Embrace and practise SCB’s brand promise of Here for Good and corporate values
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures
  • Responsible for building a culture of good conduct

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 6+ years’ experience in software engineering background with hands-on experience in Go or Java.
  • Proven experience designing and building distributed systems or high-availability backend services.
  • Strong software architecture experience, with the ability to design scalable, resilient, and maintainable distributed systems.
  • Solid knowledge of software design patterns and the ability to apply them effectively in real-world engineering solutions.
  • Solid understanding of concurrency, service-to-service communication, and failure handling.
  • Experience with high-throughput, low-latency, and resilient system design.
  • Familiarity with transactional consistency, idempotency, retries, and recovery patterns.
  • Experience working in environments with strict reliability, observability, and operational requirements.
  • Experience working on critical financial or transaction-intensive systems is highly desirable.
  • Experience with durable execution frameworks (for example Temporal, DBOS, or similar) is a strong bonus.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and workflows.
  • Experience with AI hardening design, including safe, reliable, and controlled use of AI in engineering workflows.
  • Self-driven, curious, and optimistic with a strong can-do attitude.
  • Good communication skills and a collaborative engineering mindset.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Role Specific Technical Competencies

  • Software Engineering
  • Software Development
  • Application Design
  • Architecture

  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.

CIB - Global Payments Solutions (GPS)

Global Payment Solutions (GPS) is made up of almost 10,000 colleagues across 58 countries and territories. This business is uniquely positioned to help clients make payments across borders, currencies and regulations, quickly and efficiently with dedicated in-country and regional support. Our expertise in this area is repeatedly recognised by the industry’s most prominent publications and associations with numerous global, regional, and country awards.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • To assist develop new corporate customer opportunities within your assigned region. Manage outbound initiatives to penetrate new markets and expand our footprint. Actively promote GPS products (A/R, A/P, Liquidity, Channel Management) to address specific client pain points, positioning HSBC as the partner of choice for cross-border transactional needs.
  • To track pipeline progress rigorously and analyze sales data to help with comprehensive account planning. Provide accurate forecasts and insights into leadership, ensuring alignment with regional sales targets and strategic goals.
  • To organize and execute high-impact events and marketing activities to elevate the GPS brand within the cash management business. Build and maintain long-term, trusted relationships with key stakeholders, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction and retention.
  • To engage in sales playbooks, case studies, and industry insights with the wider GPS sales network to elevate team performance. Coordinate internal resources to meet tight deadlines and specific expectations.
  • To cross-team collaborate with GPS Product and Client Management teams to deliver tailored solutions. Act as the bridge between client needs and internal capabilities to ensure seamless service delivery.
  • To support other business-related tasks and admin stuff as required.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Minimum 5 years related working experience, of which at least 3 years are related to transactional banking business or corporate relationship management, LC/MME client experience is a plus
  • Proactive, innovative and creative thinking
  • Strong interpersonal, communication and presentation skills
  • Well organized and good attention to details
  • Self-motivated, desire to learn independently and work under high pressure
  • Good command of spoken and written English and Mandarin

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

Job Description

Job Summary

The role holder will spearhead the stressed and distressed loan trading strategy of the Loan Trading, East desk within Credit Trading. This person will be responsible for making sure that proper risk analyses are done prior to risk proposals, and that relevant risk approvals are in place. Therefore, the role holder will need to be highly experienced and skilled/proven across all aspects of stressed and distressed loan trading to be convincingly effective in conveying clear, accurate ideas and the correct risk picture in securing relevant approvals and limits. In summary, the role holder will diligently manage a risk book designed to book stressed / distressed loans and secondarily trade par loans opportunistically with profitable churn within ageing limits.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • To grow meaningfully the secondary trading franchise of fixed income assets – IG, HY & Financials of issuers in Greater China (“China Credit”) for Global Credit Trading.
  • Work with Sales, e-Sales, e-Trading, Research, Capital Markets, Technology and Syndication to execute initiatives to grow the broader Global Credit franchise.
  • Awareness and understanding of the strategy and business model of the larger Trading Group and Global Credit, as appropriate to the role.
  • Ensuring effective end to end client identification, risk management, service and infrastructure.
  • Work in conjunction with other partners to ensure SCB has a best-in-class offering for the EM credit asset class especially China Local Currency Credit.

Your role

Interested in working in finance, specifically in banking, but not sure where to start? Do you want to work for a firm with a truly global footprint?

We're looking for ambitious students to join our 2027 Off-cycle Internship Program within our Global Banking business.

You’ll Get To

  • evaluate companies and develop models for M&A transactions
  • prepare industry analyses for pitches
  • get involved in the execution of live deals

Your team

You’ll be working in our Global Banking team. We’re responsible for providing coverage, advisory, capital markets and financing solutions for corporate, financial institutions and sponsor clients.

Your expertise

We’re Looking For a Candidate Who

  • is graduating between December 2027 and June 2028 and has legal working rights in Mainland China
  • has values that align with ours: hard-working, trustworthy, dedicated and collaborative
  • is a strategic thinker with strong communication skills
  • is motivated to work in a business with high demands and tight deadlines
  • can evidence how experimental and responsible use of AI can improve outcomes and efficiency

We’re looking for someone who’s curious and wants to thrive in a business that never stops moving. We welcome all majors, but it’s important to have an interest in the financial industry. We want to see what makes you unique and discover what you can bring to our team. Perhaps you’ve organized a fundraising event or taken part in team sports? Or stepped out of your comfort zone to learn about a subject you found challenging? Let us know how your achievements match the skills we’re after.

Your program

This paid internship will last six months. You’ll work with our experts and learn about the industry, our clients and our firm. You’ll be right at the heart of our business, learning from your colleagues, taking part in day-to-day operations. You'll be given mentors along the way and will have the chance to get to know some of the most senior members of our teams.

You’ll have plenty of opportunities to develop new skills and make contacts along the way. If you like challenges, enjoy learning and want to work where no two days are the same, this program is for you.

If you have a successful internship, you may get an offer to return for our Graduate Talent Program after you've completed your studies.

About Us

UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.

We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers.

Join us

At UBS, we know that it's our people, with their diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds, who drive our ongoing success. We’re dedicated to our craft and passionate about putting our people first, with new challenges, a supportive team, opportunities to grow and flexible working options when possible. Our inclusive culture brings out the best in our employees, wherever they are on their career journey. And we use artificial intelligence (AI) to work smarter and more efficiently. We also recognize that great work is never done alone. That’s why collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves.

We’re committed to disability inclusion and if you need reasonable accommodation/adjustments throughout our recruitment process, you can always contact us.

Disclaimer / Policy Statements

UBS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We respect and seek to empower each individual and support the diverse cultures, perspectives, skills and experiences within our workforce.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of AVP - Data and Analytics.

Principal responsibilities

  • Explore, cleanse and transform large volumes of customer, product, channel and interaction data across platforms including GCP and Hadoop.
  • Develop cross-sell/NBA analytics, including propensity/uplift models, segmentation, eligibility rules and prioritisation logic.
  • Engineer features from CRM and behavioural signals (e.g., digital journeys, RM activities, campaign responses) to improve model performance and interpretability.
  • Build and iterate prototypes using Python/SQL and relevant tooling; create decision-ready dashboards and monitoring views in Looker.
  • Partner with CRM, product and Business stakeholders to define use cases, success metrics and test-and-learn approaches (e.g., A/B testing, champion–challenger).
  • Communicate modelling approach, assumptions, limitations and outcomes clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Translate insights into actionable recommendations and implementation-ready artefacts (e.g., scoring outputs, business rules, playbooks, targeting lists).
  • Drive continuous improvement through automation and modern tooling (including AI/LLM-enabled approaches where appropriate) to streamline analysis and delivery.
  • Maintain strong engineering discipline (version control, documentation, reproducibility) and contribute to shared code assets.

Requirements

  • 6+ years’ experience in banking analytics/data science, with a structured and well-organised approach to delivery.
  • Strong understanding of CMB products and operating model, with particular depth in CRM and customer engagement processes.
  • Advanced Python and SQL skills, with proven experience analysing large datasets and performing complex statistical analysis.
  • Demonstrated end-to-end delivery experience (development through implementation) in at least one of the following: recommendation/next-best-action, customer propensity modelling, uplift modelling, NLP/NLU, social network analysis, or path analysis (e.g., browsing behaviour or geolocation).
  • Strong working knowledge of GCP services and analytics tooling; solid understanding of Hadoop concepts and ecosystem.
  • Proven track record of converting data into insights and delivering measurable business impact (e.g., conversion uplift, increased product penetration, improved RM productivity).
  • Strong stakeholder management, presentation and communication skills.
  • Active GitHub contributor (or equivalent evidence of strong version control and collaborative coding practices).
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills in English.

Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB)

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Responsible for the delivery of Business Credit Office (BCO) tasks in line with agreed OKRs, SLAs and KPIs
  • Own the end-to-end Credit & Lending servicing journey, ensuring a seamless and efficient process for customers and internal stakeholders
  • Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality & requisite returns on risk
  • Continuously drive improvement in their productivity whilst enhancing client experience.
  • Adopt technology and customer experience improvement initiatives, including alignment to a globally consistent C&L operating model and active participation in training initiatives
  • Participate in deal discussions and meetings with clients or credit risk as required
  • Strong execution and implementation ability.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong relationships across the teams, including credibility with both Business and Risk leaders.
  • Protect the Bank by acting as First Line of Defence and adhering to all controls
  • Maintain HSBC internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit recomentations, along with addressing any issues raised by external regulators
  • Demonstrates ability to engage in constructive and consistent dialogue with risk partners, in a manner that effectively balances commercial outcomes and risk management
  • Work with the BCO Team Lead to ensure adequate credit risk management controls are built into the operational process and robust MI is in place to track and measure risk against agreed thresholds

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • Corporate lending experience with strong analytical skills and sound credit knowledge
  • Strong understanding of various financing instruments and banking products for Wholesale Banking
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex situations and drive alignment among senior leaders
  • Clear understanding of the Group credit risk principles, policies and statutory compliances
  • Strong commercial mindset
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Delivery Management.

Business:IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

Product strategy and roadmap

  • Define the product vision, strategy and roadmap for technology capabilities related to financial market.
  • Translate investment, operations, client and regulatory requirements into prioritised product outcomes.
  • Maintain a transparent backlog and make trade-offs based on client value, business impact, risk and delivery capacity.
  • Track market and technology developments relevant to asset management.

Discovery and requirements

  • Partner with investment teams, portfolio managers, traders, bankers, operations, risk, compliance, finance, data and engineering colleagues.
  • Understand current processes, pain points, dependencies and control gaps.
  • Lead discovery workshops, user research and process analysis.
  • Create clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and operating-model documentation.
  • Ensure requirements are inclusive and reflect the needs of different users and locations.

Delivery and execution

  • Lead products through the full lifecycle: discovery, design, build, testing, launch and continuous improvement.
  • Work closely with engineering, architecture, UX, data and delivery teams.
  • Establish delivery milestones, success measures and release plans.
  • Remove blockers and communicate progress, decisions, risks and dependencies clearly.
  • Coordinate user acceptance testing, implementation readiness and post-launch reviews.

Asset-management domain alignment

Depending On The Product Area, Support Capabilities Such As

  • Portfolio and investment management workflows.
  • Order and trade management.
  • Performance and attribution.
  • Risk and compliance monitoring.
  • Investment book of record or accounting data.
  • Market, reference and security-master data.
  • Client, fund and regulatory reporting.
  • Workflow automation and straight-through processing.
  • APIs, data platforms and integration with internal or third-party systems.

Risk, controls and regulatory obligations

  • Build security, resilience, privacy, auditability and regulatory requirements into product design.
  • Partner with Risk, Compliance, Information Security, Architecture and Operational Resilience teams.
  • Maintain appropriate product documentation, controls, approvals and evidence.
  • Identify and manage product risks, technical debt and operational dependencies.
  • Ensure solutions are designed for responsible use of data and emerging technologies.

Stakeholder and vendor management

  • Develop trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and subject-matter experts.
  • Align priorities across business lines, technology teams and geographic locations.
  • Manage relevant third-party vendors and technology partners.
  • Prepare concise updates for governance forums and senior leadership.
  • Explain complex technology topics in clear business language.

Requirements

Essential experience and skills

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager, Technology Product Manager or equivalent in asset management, investment management, securities company, investment banks, commercial banks or financial services.
  • Strong understanding of trading, asset-management processes and technology.
  • Experience taking products from concept through delivery and live operation.
  • Ability to define product strategy, roadmaps, outcomes and prioritisation principles.
  • Strong knowledge of Agile product-delivery practices.
  • Experience working with engineering, data, architecture, security and control functions.
  • Excellent stakeholder-management, communication and influencing skills.
  • Ability to analyse complex problems and make sound, evidence-based decisions.
  • Experience working in a regulated environment with strong risk and control expectations.
  • Comfortable operating across business, technology and operational teams.Success measures

  • Deliver a clear and outcome-focused product roadmap.
  • Improve user experience, process efficiency and data quality.
  • Reduce manual work, operational risk and avoidable rework.
  • Deliver products safely, reliably and within agreed commitments.
  • Increase adoption and user satisfaction.
  • Strengthen controls, auditability and regulatory readiness.

Discovery and requirements
- Partner with investment teams, portfolio managers, traders, bankers, operations, risk, compliance, finance, data and engineering colleagues.
- Understand current processes, pain points, dependencies and control gaps.
- Lead discovery workshops, user research and process analysis.
- Create clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and operating-model documentation.
- Ensure requirements are inclusive and reflect the needs of different users and locations.
Delivery and execution
- Lead products through the full lifecycle: discovery, design, build, testing, launch and continuous improvement.
- Work closely with engineering, architecture, UX, data and delivery teams.
- Establish delivery milestones, success measures and release plans.
- Remove blockers and communicate progress, decisions, risks and dependencies clearly.
- Coordinate user acceptance testing, implementation readiness and post-launch reviews.

- Order and trade management.
- Performance and attribution.
- Risk and compliance monitoring.
- Investment book of record or accounting data.
- Market, reference and security-master data.
- Client, fund and regulatory reporting.
- Workflow automation and straight-through processing.
- APIs, data platforms and integration with internal or third-party systems.

- Build security, resilience, privacy, auditability and regulatory requirements into product design.
- Partner with Risk, Compliance, Information Security, Architecture and Operational Resilience teams.
- Maintain appropriate product documentation, controls, approvals and evidence.
- Identify and manage product risks, technical debt and operational dependencies.
- Ensure solutions are designed for responsible use of data and emerging technologies.

- Develop trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and subject-matter experts.
- Align priorities across business lines, technology teams and geographic locations.
- Manage relevant third-party vendors and technology partners.
- Prepare concise updates for governance forums and senior leadership.
- Explain complex technology topics in clear business language.

- Proven experience as a Product Manager, Technology Product Manager or equivalent in asset management, investment management, securities company, investment banks, commercial banks or financial services.
- Strong understanding of trading, asset-management processes and technology.
- Experience taking products from concept through delivery and live operation.
- Ability to define product strategy, roadmaps, outcomes and prioritisation principles.
- Strong knowledge of Agile product-delivery practices.
- Experience working with engineering, data, architecture, security and control functions.
- Excellent stakeholder-management, communication and influencing skills.
- Ability to analyse complex problems and make sound, evidence-based decisions.
- Experience working in a regulated environment with strong risk and control expectations.

- Deliver a clear and outcome-focused product roadmap.
- Improve user experience, process efficiency and data quality.
- Reduce manual work, operational risk and avoidable rework.
- Deliver products safely, reliably and within agreed commitments.
- Increase adoption and user satisfaction.
- Strengthen controls, auditability and regulatory readiness.
- Improve transparency across product performance, risks, dependencies and investment.
Key relationships

- Financial market business and investment teams.
- Portfolio managers, bankers, traders and research colleagues.
- Operations, fund administration and client-service teams.
- Engineering, architecture, data and infrastructure teams.
- Risk, Compliance, Legal and Information Security.
- Finance, Procurement and third-party technology providers.
- Regional and global product and transformation teams.
Personal attributes
- Customer- and user-focused.
- Pragmatic, structured and delivery-oriented.
- Comfortable making decisions in ambiguity.
- Collaborative and inclusive, with the confidence to challenge constructively.
- Accountable for outcomes rather than simply outputs.
- Curious about technology and its practical application.
- Calm and effective when managing competing priorities.
- Clear, concise and credible with both technical and senior business audiences.

The Network Analyst is an intermediate level role responsible for assisting with network related activities, including network installation, maintenance, technical guidance, and security in coordination with the Citi standard.

The overall objective is to support new company setup and continue to provide network support for securities company in BAU.

Responsibilities

  • Be responsible for the operational support of network for Citi China securities company, which includes multiple platforms, manufacturers, and technologies.
  • Participates in collaborating with various internal groups and external vendors to ensure all installations meet specifications.
  • Provide fast response to network problems of high priority, severity, and impact, escalating as appropriate.
  • Act directly on incidents and tasks of greater complexity or priority assigned to the team.
  • Excellent interpersonal relations and communication and persuasive skills; be able to manage communication with multiple audiences during problem-solving and crisis management.
  • Keep up with the Citi network/infra standard, act as SME to senior stakeholders and /or other team members.
  • Collect business requirement and interpret to proper technical components and support business to follow proper process
  • Assist project team on service ensure timely project delivery
  • Manage vendor on proper service delivery
  • Support and assist regional operation team on incident handling
  • Communicate with relevant teams to provide frequent status updates regarding the technical issue, status of the remediation efforts, and ongoing business impact
  • Exchange ideas and information in a concise and clear manner
  • Has the ability to operate with a limited level of direct supervision.
  • Can exercise independence of judgement and autonomy.
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Qualifications

  • 5-8 years of experience in a network engineer role (education/professional) with demonstrated knowledge of operational process change and improvement
  • CCNA or above
  • Experience in networks and telecommunications in large-scale environments, such as Carrier, Manufacturers, Multi-Account Global Services, or a large-scale enterprise environment.
  • Effective oral and written communication skills.
  • Effective diagnostic and analysis skills. Mature analytical and communications skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to a non-technical audience.
  • Experience in Financial Services or a broad global or complex environment preferred.
  • Ability to provide rapid response to problems, leading multidisciplinary teams virtually.
  • Ability to work with personal and virtual teams and work under pressure or for rapid resolution of critical incidents
  • Hands on experience on China Securities industry


Education

  • Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

We want to hear from you if...

You are in your penultimate year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in any discipline from a top academic institution (graduating between Dec 2027 – June 2028).

Who We Think Will Be a Great Fit...

Work experience is not a requirement, but dedication to learning and a true passion for the business are vital. As industries all over the globe continue to restructure and grow, we are hiring Analysts who have a global perspective on the future of banking and want to make an impact on the corporate level. We value diversity and so do you.

We'll Also Be Looking For The Following

  • Enthusiasm, competency, and innovation
  • Someone with a global outlook
  • Interest in working with local SME
  • Results-oriented and a good team player
  • Someone who is highly numerate with first-class analytical skills


We encourage early applications as we recruit on a rolling basis. Each applicant can apply to maximum of 3 summer internship programs in Asia cluster.

We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.

We're committed to teaching you the ropes. The Summer Analyst Program trains and cultivates key pipeline for our Full-time Analyst Program. Summer Analysts will be part of a 10-week program will be assigned in Citi's key businesses or functions allowing them to work on project for an in-depth and immersive experience. Summer Analysts will also go through trainings that will provide essential skills knowledge as well as a comprehensive orientation to Citi's culture. To support your growth, you will also participate in buddy programs, networking events, speaker series, and other structured development opportunities.

Your time here will look something like this...

The Summer Analyst Program is dedicated to giving future business leaders a complete view of Citi's business. Through mentorship, training and career development programming, Summer Analysts can expect to finish the program with broad understanding of the Commercial Banking business, as well as operational intricacies of Citi.

Tailored projects for Summer Analysts could be within these business areas:

  • Relationship management
  • Credit Lending Management
  • Client segment strategy
  • Business planning and analysis
  • Know Your Customer (KYC) and Control
  • Process design


You're the brains behind our work.

You're ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the boardroom, and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it's honing your skills or building your network. we know that success can't come without growth. Our programs equip you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team, and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility, and career growth is not a question of if, but when.

Citi’s Banking is looking for Summer Interns to join Commercial Banking team in Asia. Citi Commercial Bank (CCB) is a global line of business at Citigroup that provides commercial banking services to mid-sized companies. CCB aspires to be the global bank of choice for trade-oriented companies, with revenues between $10MM - $3B. CCB wants our clients to see us as trusted thought partners who bring simplicity in an increasingly complex world, provide client-centric solutions for long term growth and pave the way for them to reach across borders and achieve their global vision. The main products and services, that support the Commercial Bank target segment, include: Lending, Cash Management, Trade, Foreign Exchange, Interest Rate Derivatives and Capital Markets solutions. In Asia, CCB has operations in 12 countries and jurisdictions (approximately 1,200 employees) with local and international expertise contributed by our bankers, underwriters, treasury management and client service staff located in each of the 12 countries and jurisdictions. CCB Asia is a significant business for Citi in Asia and for CCB globally.

The Banker is a senior level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team. The VP Banker also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients. The overall objective of this role is to act as a strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.

Responsibilities:

  • Assume significant levels of responsibility for the various phases of project and transaction execution, new business development and overall growth of the firm
  • Work closely with clients on financing transactions and guide them through the capital raising process, including leading due diligence and drafting sessions and preparing them for an equity or debt offering
  • Work with clients, senior-level team members and outside professional advisors on M&A and special situation transactions
  • Responsible for drafting situation analyses, pitch materials, information memoranda, investor and management presentations and oversee work being performed by analysts & associates assigned to projects

Recommended Qualifications:

  • 6-10 years of experience
  • Experience in the Financial Services industry, specifically within Banking
  • Degree in Finance or closely related areas of Business Administration
  • MBA or Master's Degree in Business preferred
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the corporate banking business and its related products, pertinent regulations and lending and credit approval processes
  • Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience with large corporate clients, capital markets products, derivatives, credit, cash management, trade, finance and securities products
  • Series 7 and 63 preferred

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master’s degree preferred
